name: Samosa
description: Crispy pastry snack with different fillings, including vegetable, chicken and meat versions. Ask which fillings are available.

name: Pakora
description: Spiced battered snack, with varieties including vegetable and chicken pakoras.

name: Seekh kebab
description: Spiced minced meat shaped around a skewer and grilled. Varieties include chicken and lamb seekh kebabs, and cheesy chicken seekh kebabs.

name: Shami kebab
description: Soft, round patty usually made from minced meat, lentils and spices.

name: Chicken tikka
description: Marinated pieces of chicken cooked in a tandoor or on a grill.

name: Chaat
description: Tangy snack combining ingredients such as chickpeas, potato, yoghurt, chutney and crunchy toppings.

name: Chana chaat
description: Chickpea-based chaat with spices, chutney and often chopped vegetables.

name: Aloo tikki
description: Spiced potato patty, usually shallow-fried until golden.

name: Spring roll
description: Thin pastry roll with a savoury filling, fried until crisp.

name: Chapati (roti)
description: Soft, thin, unleavened flatbread, commonly eaten with curry.

name: Naan
description: Softer, thicker flatbread traditionally baked in a tandoor oven.

name: Paratha
description: Flatbread cooked with oil or ghee, often flaky and sometimes stuffed.

name: Keema naan
description: Naan stuffed with seasoned minced meat.

name: Peshwari naan
description: Naan with a sweet filling, often coconut, raisins and nuts.

name: Raita
description: Cooling yoghurt side, often mixed with cucumber, herbs or spices.

name: Chutney
description: Sauce or relish; mint, tamarind and chilli varieties can taste very different.

name: Achaar (pickle)
description: Strongly flavoured, spiced pickle served in small amounts.

name: Karahi
description: Curry cooked in a wok-like pan, often with tomato, ginger and spices.

name: Korma
description: Usually a mild, rich curry, sometimes made with yoghurt, cream or nuts.

name: Bhuna
description: A curry style where spices and sauce are cooked down for a thicker coating.

name: Daal
description: A dish made with lentils or split pulses, ranging from soupy to thick.

name: Chana masala
description: Spiced chickpea curry.

name: Keema
description: Minced meat cooked with spices, sometimes with peas or potatoes.

name: Biryani
description: Seasoned rice cooked or layered with meat or vegetables and aromatic spices.

name: Pilau rice
description: Rice cooked with spices and sometimes stock, vegetables or other additions.

name: Tandoori
description: Food cooked in a traditional clay oven, often marinated before cooking.

name: Mithai
description: General name for South Asian sweets, often made with milk, sugar, flour, nuts or syrup.

name: Jalebi
description: Bright orange, spiral-shaped fried sweet soaked in syrup.

name: Gulab jamun
description: Soft round sweet soaked in fragrant sugar syrup.

name: Barfi
description: Dense milk-based sweet cut into squares or diamonds, sometimes flavoured with nuts.

name: Rasmalai
description: Soft cheese-based dumplings served in sweetened, flavoured milk.

name: Ladoo (laddu)
description: Round sweet made from ingredients such as gram flour, semolina or lentils.

name: Peda
description: Small, soft milk-based sweet, often flavoured with cardamom.

name: Patisa (soan papdi)
description: Light, flaky sweet that breaks into fine strands.

name: Halwa
description: Rich sweet dish that may be made from semolina, carrots or other ingredients.

name: Kheer
description: Creamy rice pudding often flavoured with cardamom and nuts.

name: Falooda
description: Cold dessert drink or sundae with vermicelli, syrup, milk and often ice cream.

name: Aloo
description: Potato.

name: Chana
description: Chickpeas.

name: Murgh
description: Chicken.

name: Gosht
description: Meat; the specific type varies, so ask.

name: Sabzi
description: Vegetables or a vegetable dish.

name: Meetha
description: Sweet.

name: Teekha
description: Spicy or hot.

name: Mild
description: Usually less chilli heat, though spice levels vary between kitchens.
